note: RUBRIC_SLIM_SPEC batch: old U6 L8-11 (two-proportion intervals and tests; NEW Unit 3). CB scoring: interval = procedure + conditions (1), mechanics (1), interpretation in context with 'confident' and the parameter (1), conclusion about the claim from whether 0 is inside (1); confidence LEVEL interpretation is its own idea (repeated samples, capture rate). Test = hypotheses with parameters (1), procedure + conditions (1), mechanics z and p (1), conclusion comparing p to alpha in context (1). Applied with scripts/rubric-slim-apply.mjs. Revised after the Codex review of new U3/U4 (DO NOT SHIP -> fixed): a full inference procedure requires the ids that compose College Board's four compound points (hypotheses incl. parameter, procedure + every condition, mechanics with work, decision + justification in context) even when that is 6-8 ids; explicitly requested interpretations and reasons restored; E/P/I made uniform and disjoint (all / all-but-one / two-or-more).
